facts.text: Mii amo is a resort spa located in Boynton Canyon in Sedona, Arizona.
facts.excerpt: Mii amo is a Forbes Five-Star resort spa located in Sedona, Arizona’s Boynton Canyon.

facts.text: Boynton Canyon is naturally formed in the shape of a horseshoe and surrounds the resort.
facts.excerpt: Naturally formed in the shape of a horseshoe, the canyon surrounds and envelopes the resort and all who enter.

facts.text: Mii amo says it is located in one of Sedona's major energy vortexes.
facts.excerpt: Located in one of Sedona’s major energy vortexes, Mii amo has a unique ability to enable profound wellbeing.

facts.text: Mii amo has been recognized as a leader among destination spas since 2001.
facts.excerpt: Since 2001 Mii amo has been recognized as a leader amongst destination spa and wellbeing resorts

facts.text: Forbes Travel Guide recognized Mii amo as the first and only wellness-focused Forbes Five-Star resort in North America.
facts.excerpt: Mii amo has officially been recognized by Forbes Travel Guide as the _First_ and _Only_ Wellness Focused Forbes Five-Star Resort in North America!

facts.text: Mii amo was designed by co-owner and original architect Dana Tang of Gluckman Tang.
facts.excerpt:
designed by co-owner and original architect Dana Tang of
Gluckman Tang

facts.text: Architect Dana Tang says the renovation's design frames the red rock walls and brings natural light into every space of the building.
facts.excerpt: design that frames the red rock walls and landscape, brings natural light into every space of the building, and connects the guest to the Canyon.

facts.text: All accommodations include fireplaces, private outdoor spaces and heated bathroom floors, arranged within a quiet courtyard compound.
facts.excerpt: All accommodations include fireplaces, private outdoor spaces, and heated bathroom floors and are arranged within a quiet courtyard compound.

facts.text: The casitas are arranged in a private enclave shaded by cottonwood trees.
facts.excerpt: Artfully arranged in a private enclave shaded by cottonwood trees

facts.text: Luxury Suites feature separate living areas, a private massage room, an outdoor shower and a large private courtyard with fireplace and whirlpool.
facts.excerpt: Our Luxury Suites feature separate living areas, a designated private massage room, an outdoor shower and a large private courtyard with fireplace and whirlpool.

facts.text: Mii amo offers all-inclusive Journeys of three, four, seven or 10 nights for guests aged 16 and over.
facts.excerpt: The award-winning property invites guests _(ages 16+)_ to embark on three, four, seven or 10-night all-inclusive Journeys.

facts.text: Journey packages include a daily credit for spa services or Trail House or Artist Cottage activities.
facts.excerpt: Generous daily credit for spa services or Trail House or Artist Cottage activities

facts.text: Journey packages include all taxes, gratuities and fees on accommodations, spa services, and food and beverage.
facts.excerpt: All taxes, gratuities and fees on accommodations, spa services, and food and beverage

facts.text: A personal Journey Guide works alongside each guest to create a Journey tailored to their needs.
facts.excerpt: Your personal Journey Guide will work alongside you, intentionally creating a Journey tailored to your needs in the present moment.

facts.text: The Crystal Grotto is a circular space with an earthen floor and domed ceiling, centered on a petrified wood pedestal with a fountain and an illuminated quartz crystal.
facts.excerpt: This circular space, with its earthen floor and domed ceiling, centers around a pedestal of petrified wood featuring a gentle fountain and an illuminated quartz crystal.

facts.text: On the summer solstice, a beam of sunlight through the Crystal Grotto's overhead aperture strikes the crystal.
facts.excerpt: Lit by an aperture overhead, it is designed so that once a year, on the summer solstice, a beam of sunlight strikes the crystal, connecting earth and sky.

facts.text: The Crystal Grotto is an ideal site for daily meditation and reflection.
facts.excerpt: the Crystal Grotto has been refreshed and remains an ideal site for daily meditation and reflection.

facts.text: Outdoor spaces include a Sensory Garden with a reflexology path, a labyrinth and a yoga lawn, all with views of the red rock walls.
facts.excerpt: a Sensory Garden with a reflexology path, and expanded outdoor dining, an outdoor lounge and fireplace. Other landscape features include a labyrinth and a yoga lawn, all with views of the surrounding red rock walls.

facts.text: A private plunge pool is available for Journey guests.
facts.excerpt: In addition, a private plunge pool is available for Journey guests.

facts.text: The Journey Lounge has a fireplace, lounge chairs, a library and space for lectures and presentations.
facts.excerpt: The Journey Lounge is a place for Journey guests to unwind, study and listen – with a fireplace, lounge chairs, library and space for lectures and presentations.

facts.text: The Living Room features a sunken seating lounge.
facts.excerpt: The Living Room features a sunken seating lounge allowing guests to relax and connect to the earth

facts.text: The Boynton Canyon Vortex Hike goes from the resort to the energy center of Boynton Canyon with a guided meditation.
facts.excerpt: Hike from the resort to the energy center of Boynton Canyon. During this hike you will pause to listen, reflect, and participate in a calming guided meditation experience

facts.text: In the Spirit of the New Moon ceremony, a guest's written intention is held for one lunar cycle and then buried in the canyon.
facts.excerpt: we hold on to your written intention for one lunar cycle and on the following new moon we bury it in the canyon

facts.text: Aura photographs are taken before and after a guided meditation, followed by an in-depth reading.
facts.excerpt: your aura photograph is taken both before and after a guided meditation so your practitioner may provide you with an in-depth reading

facts.text: Hummingbird, the signature restaurant, sources seasonal produce from its own Chef's Garden and nearby farms, ranches and orchards.
facts.excerpt: The restaurant sources seasonal produce from its own Chef’s Garden as well as from nearby farms, ranches and orchards.

facts.text: Mii amo welcomes guests ages 16 and over.
facts.excerpt: Mii amo welcomes guests ages 16+

facts.text: Concierge can arrange tennis lessons with a pro at sister property Enchantment Resort.
facts.excerpt:
tennis lessons with a pro at sister property,
Enchantment Resort

facts.text: Mii amo is a secluded hideaway within the Boynton Canyon vortex, away from downtown Sedona.
facts.excerpt: It's a secluded hideaway set within the Boynton Canyon vortex, known for spiritual and healing energy, and away from the hustle and bustle of downtown Sedona.

facts.text: The Labyrinth Walk is a walking meditation along a circular, stone-lined maze modeled after a Bronze Age Trojaborg labyrinth.
facts.excerpt: the Labyrinth Walk, a walking meditation along a circular, stone-lined maze modeled after a Trojaborg labyrinth dating to the Bronze Age

facts.text: Mii amo reopened after a two-year closure following a $40 million overhaul and expansion.
facts.excerpt: has just reopened after a two-year closure. Now, following a $40 million complete overhaul and expansion

facts.text: Three-night Journeys have Thursday arrivals.
facts.excerpt: **3-Night Journeys** – Thursday arrivals

facts.text: Four-night Journeys have Sunday arrivals.
facts.excerpt: **4-Night Journeys** – Sunday arrivals
